cr_loneford_st_1.m: Didn't you hear? They have all gotten ill.

cr_loneford_st_10.m: I tell you. Savages - that's what they are. No respect for the laws or authority.

cr_loneford_st_2.m: It all started a few days ago. As the story goes, someone found one of the farmers passed out in one of the fields, completely white faced and shivering.

cr_loneford_st_3.m: A few days later, the same symptoms started to show on a lot more people.

cr_loneford_st_4.m: Then, all people showed the symptoms in one way or another.

cr_loneford_st_6.m: Everyone started investigating what could be the cause. Currently, the cause is still unknown.

cr_loneford_st_7.m: Luckily, now Feygard has sent patrols up there to help guard the village at least. The people are still suffering though.

cr_loneford_st_8.m: Me, I am certain that this is the work of those savages from Nor City somehow. They probably sabotaged something up there.

cr_loneford_st_9.m: What do they call it, the 'Shadow'? They are willing to do almost anything to upset the law and order around here.

gandoren_1.m: Hello there. Welcome to the Crossroads guardhouse. How may I help you?
r: You guards seem to have a lot of equipment here, anything to trade?

gandoren_10.m: Pay? Oh, I guess we could pay you.

gandoren_11.m: I need you to take a shipment of equipment to another one of our outposts further south on the Duleian road.

gandoren_12.m: Those outposts further down south are in greater need of equipment than us, them being closer to that wretched Nor City and all.

gandoren_13.m: Take this shipment of 10 iron swords to the guard captain stationed in a tavern called 'The Foaming Flask', near a village called Vilegard.
r: No problem. Anything for the glory of Feygard.
You did not mention any amount that I would be paid.
Why should I help you people? I have only heard bad things about Feygard.
I had better not get involved in your Feygard business.

gandoren_14.m: Bad things? Who have you been talking to then? I would urge you to make up your own opinion of Feygard by travelling there yourself.

gandoren_15.m: Personally, I cannot think of a greater place to be than in Feygard. Order is kept and people are friendly.

gandoren_16.m: As to why you would help us, I can only say that Feygard would be grateful for your services if you help us.
r: Fine, whatever. I will carry your stupid swords. I still hope there will be some reward for this.
Sounds good to me. Anything for the glory of Feygard.
I had better not get involved in your Feygard business.

gandoren_18.m: I cannot promise you any amount on a reward.

gandoren_2.m: This guardhouse is a safe haven for merchants travelling the Duleian road. We keep law and order around here, for Feygard.

gandoren_20.m: Here is the shipment that I want you to transport.

gandoren_21.m: As I said, you should deliver those 10 iron swords to the guard captain stationed in a tavern called 'The Foaming Flask', near a village called Vilegard.

gandoren_22.m: Return to me once you are done.

gandoren_23.m: I feel that I should warn you about something also. See that fellow over there in the corner? Ailshara. She seems very interested in our dealings for some reason.

gandoren_24.m: I would urge you to stay away from her at all costs. Whatever you do, do not speak to her about your mission with the shipment.

gandoren_3.m: Oh sure. Recently, we have had to focus our attention to the troubles up in Loneford.

gandoren_4.m: That situation has forced us to be more alert than usual, and we have had to send some guards up there to help them.

gandoren_5.m: This also means that we cannot focus as much on our usual tasks as we normally do, but instead need help with doing basic tasks just to hold our grounds.
r: What troubles in Loneford are you referring to?
Anything I can do to help?

gandoren_6.m: Well, we usually do not employ just any civilian. Our tasks are important for Feygard - and by extension, important for the people. Our tasks are usually not suited for commoners like you.

gandoren_7.m: But I guess the recent situation really leaves us no choice. We need to keep the guards in Loneford, and we also need to deliver this shipment. At the moment, we cannot do both.

gandoren_8.m: Tell you what, you might be able to help us after all if you are willing to work.
r: Anything for the glory of Feygard.
If the pay is sufficient, I guess I can help.
I had better not get involved in your Feygard business.

gandoren_completed_1.m: You return. Thank you for helping with the shipment earlier.

gandoren_completed_2.m: Is there anything I can do for you?
r: Do you have anything to trade?

gandoren_deliver_1.m: You return. Good news about the shipment I hope?
r: You guards seem to have a lot of equipment here, anything to trade?
I am still working on transporting that shipment.
What was I supposed to do again?
Yes. I have delivered them as you ordered.
I'd rather talk about the troubles in Loneford that you had mentioned.

gandoren_deliver_n_1.m: Splendid! Feygard is in debt to you.

gandoren_deliver_y_1.m: Splendid! Feygard is in debt to you.

gandoren_delivered_1.m: I hope you managed to stay away from the savages of Nor City as much as possible while being over there.

gandoren_delivered_2.m: From what I hear, things are rough down south.

gandoren_delivered_3.m: As for you, you have both my and the rest of the Feygard patrol's gratitude for helping us with this.

gandoren_dr_1.m: Noticed the large road outside? That's the Duleian road. It goes all the way from the glorious city of Feygard up in the northwest down to the wretched Nor City in the southeast.

gandoren_noguards_1.m: Hello again. Welcome to the Crossroads guardhouse. How may I help you?
r: Can you tell me again what you told me before about recent events?

gandoren_rej_1.m: I'm sorry to hear that. Good day to you.

gandoren_tr_1.m: I'm sorry, we only trade with allies of Feygard.

gandoren_tr_2.m: I'm sorry, we only trade with allies of Feygard. Help me with the task I gave you and we might be able to work something out.

gandoren_tr_4.m: Absolutely, as thanks for the help you provided earlier to both Minarra and me, we could agree to trade with you.

gandoren_tr_5.m: Go up in the lookout tower over there and talk to Minarra about equipment. She has our supply.

gandoren_tr_6.m: I hear that Minarra up in the lookout tower over there wants help with something. Why don't you go up to her and ask her about it, and we might be able to work something out after that.

gandoren_wantshelp_1.m: Hello again. Welcome to the Crossroads guardhouse. How may I help you?
r: What was that you told me before about a shipment?

loneford.10: I heard a story about Loneford. Apparently, a lot of people have become ill there recently, and some have even died. The cause is still unknown.
loneford.11: I should investigate what could have caused the people of Loneford to become ill. To gather clues, I should ask the citizens of Loneford and the surrounding areas about what they think is the cause.
loneford.21: The guards in the Crossroads guardhouse are certain that the illness in Loneford is caused by some sabotage done by the priests or people from Nor City.
loneford.22: Some villagers in Loneford believe that the illness is caused by the guards from Feygard, in some scheme to make the people suffer even more than they already have.
loneford.23: Talion, the chapel priest in Loneford, thinks that the illness is the work of the Shadow, as punishment for Loneford's lack of devotion to the Shadow.
loneford.24: Taevinn in Loneford is certain that Sienn in the southeast barn has something to do with the illness. Apparently, Sienn keeps a pet around that has approached Taevinn in a threatening manner several times.
loneford.25: I should go see Landa in the Loneford tavern. Rumor has it that he saw something that he doesn't dare tell anyone.
loneford.30: Landa confused me with someone else at first. He apparently saw a boy doing something around the town well during the night before the illness started. He was scared to talk to me at first since he thought I looked like the boy he had seen. Could it have been Andor that he saw?
loneford.31: Also, the night after he saw the boy at the well, he saw Buceth taking samples of the water in the well. Strangely enough, Buceth has not gotten ill like the others in the village.
loneford.35: I should go question Buceth at the Loneford chapel about what he was doing at the well, and about whether he knows anything about Andor.
loneford.41: I have bribed Buceth into talking to me.
loneford.42: I have told Buceth that I am ready to follow the Shadow.
loneford.45: Buceth tells me that he is assigned by the priests in Nor City to make sure the Shadow casts its glow over Loneford. Apparently, the priests had sent a boy to do some business in Loneford, and Buceth was tasked with gathering some samples from the water well.
loneford.50: I have attacked Buceth. I should bring any evidence that Buceth has on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in the longhouse in Loneford.
loneford.54: I have given the vial that Buceth had on him to Kuldan, the guard captain in Loneford.
loneford.55: Kuldan thanked me for solving the mystery of the illness in Loneford. They will start bringing in water with help from Feygard instead of drinking from the well from now on. Kuldan also told me to visit the castle steward in Feygard if I want to help further.
loneford.60: I have promised to keep Buceth's story a secret. If Andor was indeed here, he must have had a good reason for doing what he did. Buceth also told me to visit the chapel custodian in Nor City if I want to learn more about the Shadow.

rogorn: The path is clear to me

rogorn.10: Minarra up in the tower at the Crossroads guardhouse has seen a band of rogues heading west from the guardhouse, towards Carn Tower. Minarra was sure they matched the description of some men whose heads have a bounty on them from the Feygard patrol. If these are the men that Minarra thinks, they are supposedly led by particularly ruthless savage named Rogorn.
rogorn.20: I am helping Minarra find the band of rogues. I should travel the road west from the Crossroads guardhouse towards Carn Tower and look for them. They have supposedly stolen three pieces of a valuable painting and are wanted dead for their crimes.
rogorn.21: Minarra also tells me that I should not trust anything I hear from them. In particular, anything from Rogorn should be viewed with great suspicion.
rogorn.30: I have found the band of rogues on the road west towards Carn Tower, led by Rogorn.
rogorn.35: Rogorn tells me that they are wrongly accused of murder and theft in Feygard, while they themselves have never even been to Feygard.
rogorn.40: I have decided to attack Rogorn and his band of rogues. I should return to Minarra with the three pieces of the painting once they are dead.
rogorn.45: I have decided not to attack Rogorn and his band of rogues, but instead report back to Minarra that she must have mistaken the men she saw for someone else.
rogorn.50: Minarra thanked me for dealing with the thieves, and told me that my services to Feygard will be appreciated.
rogorn.55: After telling Minarra that she must have mistaken the men for someone else, she seemed a bit suspicious, but thanked me for helping her look into the matter.
rogorn.60: I have helped Minarra with her task.

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.
